intro_line: A mountain-ringed capital of salsa, arepas and chaotic energy.
intro: Caracas rewards visitors with vibrant neighbourhoods, mountain views and a lively food scene, though safety needs care. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: Metro is clean, cheap and fast; buy a single, round trip or 10-journey multi abono.
Metrobuses link metro stations to areas off the underground, but run roughly every 20 minutes.
Por puesto minibuses are cheap but slow, crowded and often in poor condition.
Taxis have no meters; agree the price first and expect quotes near double the fair fare.
Ride apps like Uber and inDrive work in Caracas but coverage varies; confirm before relying on them.
Driving is hectic; walking is fine by day in safe districts, but avoid quiet streets after dark.

airports.name: Maiquetia Simon Bolivar Internacional Airport
airports.note: Main international gateway, about 17 km straight-line and 28 km by road from downtown.

options.to: Gato Negro metro or Parque Central
options.note: Cheapest option; Gato Negro street level is unsafe, so continue by metro.
You need not be a hotel guest; ask at the tourist offices in the international terminal.
Agree the fare first; prefer official black Ford Explorer cabs and avoid shared rides.
Availability is patchy; book only after landing and confirm the driver.
